Your father probably also had a very abusive father of his own, like my dad did, and might be suffering from anger issues too. He was taught at a young age to keep himself guarded because the person he trusted the most would hurt him. He also keeps his emotions a secret until they explode because, mistakenly, he thinks keeping them bottles up will keep the ones he loves safe from his anger.

Regardless of that, my goal is to learn from my father. Learn from his successes, and learn how to not repeat the same mistakes he did.
